description: Optional source-bound country context for editorial Overall Ranking lenses. A field is used only when value, source and as_of are present.

annual_rain_days.description: Representative long-term annual number of days with measurable precipitation

restaurant_beer_price_usd.description: Documented representative restaurant beer price; city/country grain must be stated

liveable_city_recognition.description: Current source-named recognition of one or more cities; exact edition required

conflict_exposure.description: Reviewed exposure to nearby active conflict and plausible spillover; not a war forecast

alliance_exposure.description: Reviewed deterrence and obligation context beyond membership alone

daily_climate_impact.description: Observed climate effects relevant to everyday life, kept separate from coping capacity

visa_work_access.description: Reviewed accessibility of a stated work-migration route for a stated applicant scope

permanent_residence_access.description: Reviewed longer-term residence pathway for a stated applicant scope

integration_policy_context.description: Source-bound policy context, distinct from migrant outcomes or population share
